summary: Ford Credit Auto Receivables Two LLC filed an 8-K to report entry into an underwriting agreement for a securitization transaction. The filing relates to the issuance of asset-backed notes by Ford Credit Auto Owner Trust 2026-B, a typical structured finance vehicle. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a routine current report for a material definitive agreement in the context of an ordinary shelf takedown of asset-backed securities. Therefore, this filing does not represent a special situation.
